content.short: Fireblocks Embedded Wallet lets users manage digital assets securely without a third-party custodian.
content.description: Developers can build and embed secure non-custodial MPC wallets into iOS, Android, or web applications. Wallet SDKs provide flexible building blocks that let teams tailor non-custodial key management solutions to their unique requirements. This integration delivers a safeguarded, seamless approach to storing, protecting, and managing digital assets across multiple chains and environments, helping apps offer robust non-custodial wallet experiences without sacrificing control or compliance.
content.meta: Create and embed secure non-custodial MPC wallets for apps. Discover Fireblocks Embedded Wallet and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
